title: Looks aren't everything. Believe me, I'm a model.
speaker: Cameron Russell

sentences.en: Translator: Joseph Geni Reviewer: Morton Bast Hi. My name is Cameron Russell,
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是Cameron Russell,过去的一段时间里我是个模特其实，（我干了）10年。现在，我在这个房间内感到一种令人不适的紧张感因为我不该穿这条裙子（笑声）

sentences.en: and for the last little while, I've been a model.
sentences.zh: 因为我不该穿这条裙子（笑声）幸亏我带了另外一套

sentences.en: Actually, for 10 years. And I feel like there's an uncomfortable tension in the room right now because I should not have worn this dress.
sentences.zh: 幸亏我带了另外一套这是TED讲台上第一次现场换装所以我觉得今天在场的人都很幸运啊，如果有些女士对的我出现感到惊恐不必现在告诉我。但我马上就会在twitter上知道的

sentences.en: (Laughter) So luckily, I brought an outfit change.
sentences.zh: 不必现在告诉我。但我马上就会在twitter上知道的（笑声）

sentences.en: This is the first outfit change on the TED stage, so you guys are pretty lucky to witness it, I think.
sentences.zh: （笑声）我也想告诉各位我有幸能够在10秒内

sentences.en: If some of the women were really horrified when I came out, you don't have to tell me now, but I'll find out later on Twitter.
sentences.zh: 能够在10秒内改变我在你们心中的形象这不是所有人都能做得到的

sentences.en: (Laughter) I'd also note that I'm quite privileged to be able to transform what you think of me in a very brief 10 seconds.
sentences.zh: 这不是所有人都能做得到的这双高跟鞋很不舒服而好消息是我不打算穿他们最坏的消息是我要把这件毛衣从头上套进去因为这时候你们会笑我所以当我穿衣服的时候,（你们）什么都不要做

sentences.en: Not everybody gets to do that. These heels are very uncomfortable, so good thing I wasn't going to wear them.
sentences.zh: 所以当我穿衣服的时候,（你们）什么都不要做可以了那么，我为什么做这个呢（现场换装）？

sentences.en: The worst part is putting this sweater over my head, because that's when you'll all laugh at me, so don't do anything while it's over my head.
sentences.zh: 这很怪呃希望不会像图片上这样怪

sentences.en: All right. So, why did I do that? That was awkward.
sentences.zh: 希望不会像图片上这样怪图象是强大的但同时又是表面化的

sentences.en: (Laughter) Well -- (Laughter) Hopefully not as awkward as that picture.
sentences.zh: 但同时又是表面化的我只是在6秒内就彻底改变了自己在你们心中的形象在这张照片里我事实上在现实生活中根本没有男朋友

sentences.en: Image is powerful, but also, image is superficial.
sentences.zh: 我事实上在现实生活中根本没有男朋友当摄影师要我弓起背，摸那个男士的头发时

sentences.en: I just totally transformed what you thought of me, in six seconds.
sentences.zh: 我非常不自在确定的是，除了手术

sentences.en: And in this picture, I had actually never had a boyfriend in real life.
sentences.zh: 确定的是，除了手术或像两天前我为了工作做的棕褐色(皮肤)我们基本上是没法改变外表的

sentences.en: I was totally uncomfortable, and the photographer was telling me to arch my back and put my hand in that guy's hair.
sentences.zh: 我们基本上是没法改变外表的我们的外表，虽然是表面化的，固定的还是极大地影响着我们的生活

sentences.en: And of course, barring surgery, or the fake tan that I got two days ago for work, there's very little that we can do to transform how we look, and how we look, though it is superficial and immutable,
sentences.zh: 还是极大地影响着我们的生活所以今天，对我来说，变的无惧就意味着要诚实今天我站在这里是因为我是个模特我在这个舞台上是因为我是个漂亮的白种女性

sentences.en: has a huge impact on our lives. So today, for me, being fearless means being honest.
sentences.zh: 我在这个舞台上是因为我是个漂亮的白种女性在我们业内我们称此为“性感女孩”我要回答下人们常常问我的那些问题(而且是)以一种诚实的方式第一个问题是，你是怎么成为模特的？

sentences.en: And I am on this stage because I am a model.
sentences.zh: 第一个问题是，你是怎么成为模特的？我总是说：“我是被发现的”，但这其实什么也说明不了

sentences.en: I am on this stage because I am a pretty, white woman, and in my industry, we call that a sexy girl.
sentences.zh: 我总是说：“我是被发现的”，但这其实什么也说明不了我成为模特的真正的原因是我拥有极佳的基因，我是遗产的接受者

sentences.en: I'm going to answer the questions that people always ask me, but with an honest twist.
sentences.zh: 我拥有极佳的基因，我是遗产的接受者你可能在疑问什么是遗产.呃，在过去的几个世纪里

sentences.en: So the first question is, how do you become a model?
sentences.zh: 呃，在过去的几个世纪里我们定义里的美不仅仅只包括健康，年轻

sentences.en: I always just say, "Oh, I was scouted," but that means nothing.
sentences.zh: 我们定义里的美不仅仅只包括健康，年轻

sentences.en: The real way that I became a model is I won a genetic lottery, and I am the recipient of a legacy, and maybe you're wondering what is a legacy.
sentences.zh: 我们定义里的美不仅仅只包括健康，年轻和身材匀称这些我们出于生物本能去赞美的元素还包括高挑，苗条的体型，

sentences.en: Well, for the past few centuries we have defined beauty not just as health and youth and symmetry that we're biologically programmed to admire,
sentences.zh: 还包括高挑，苗条的体型，富有女性气质，白色皮肤这些特征。这就是我的遗产，这就是我一直在兑现的遗产，我知道你们中有些人可能对这个观点存疑你们可能会举出一些时尚圈人物，例如

sentences.en: but also as tall, slender figures, and femininity and white skin.
sentences.zh:
你们可能会举出一些时尚圈人物，例如Naomi, Tyra, Joan Smalls和Liu Wen
(前三位为黑人模特，第四位为中国模特)首先，我要表扬下你们对于模特界的了解令人印象深刻

sentences.en: And this is a legacy that was built for me, and it's a legacy that I've been cashing out on.
sentences.zh: 首先，我要表扬下你们对于模特界的了解令人印象深刻（笑声）但不幸的是，我得告诉你们，在2007年时

sentences.en: And I know there are people in the audience who are skeptical at this point, and maybe there are some fashionistas who are like, "Wait. Naomi. Tyra. Joan Smalls. Liu Wen."
sentences.zh: 但不幸的是，我得告诉你们，在2007年时一名纽约大学的博士在启发之下统计了所有在职模特的人数在677名正式受雇模特中

sentences.en: And first, I commend you on your model knowledge. Very impressive.
sentences.zh: 在677名正式受雇模特中只有27名，也就是不到百分之四，是非白种人

sentences.en: (Laughter) But unfortunately, I have to inform you that in 2007, a very inspired NYU Ph.D. student counted all the models on the runway, every single one that was hired, and of the 677 models that were hired,
sentences.zh: 只有27名，也就是不到百分之四，是非白种人下一个人们常问我的问题是“我长大了能当模特吗？”我的第一个答案是：“我也不知道，因为他们没让我来掌管这件事”但第二个答案，也是我想对问问题的那些小姑娘说的是“为什么？”

sentences.en: only 27, or less than four percent, were non-white.
sentences.zh: 但第二个答案，也是我想对问问题的那些小姑娘说的是“为什么？”你知道吗？你可以选择任何的职业。你可以成为美国总统

sentences.en: The next question people always ask is, "Can I be a model when I grow up?"
sentences.zh: 或是下一代互联网的发明者或是个忍者般的心胸外科诗人,

sentences.en: And the first answer is, "I don't know, they don't put me in charge of that."
sentences.zh: 或是个忍者般的心胸外科诗人,--这个不错，因为你会是第一个（笑声）

sentences.en: But the second answer, and what I really want to say to these little girls is, "Why? You know? You can be anything.
sentences.zh: （笑声）如果，听完这些她们还是说“不，不，Cameron，我想当模特”我会说：“当我的老板吧”

sentences.en: You could be the President of the United States, or the inventor of the next Internet, or a ninja cardiothoracic surgeon poet, which would be awesome, because you'd be the first one."
sentences.zh: 我会说：“当我的老板吧”因为我不能决定任何事你可以成为美国Vogue杂志的主编或是H&M的首席执行官，或下一个Steven Meisel(著名时尚摄影师)说你长大后想当模特

sentences.en: (Laughter) If, after this amazing list, they still are like, "No, no, Cameron, I want to be a model," well, then I say, "Be my boss."
sentences.zh: 说你长大后想当模特就像你说你长大后想赢彩票一样（能不能成为模特）不在你的掌控范围之内。当模特很棒

sentences.en: Because I'm not in charge of anything, and you could be the editor in chief of American Vogue or the CEO of H&M, or the next Steven Meisel.
sentences.zh: （能不能成为模特）不在你的掌控范围之内。当模特很棒但它不是一个可规划的行业我将为大家展示我模特从业十年的一些经验

sentences.en: Saying that you want to be a model when you grow up is akin to saying that you want to win the Powerball when you grow up.
sentences.zh: 我将为大家展示我模特从业十年的一些经验因为不像一个忍者般的心胸科诗人它只能立足当下所以如果摄影师就在这里

sentences.en: It's out of your control, and it's awesome, and it's not a career path.
sentences.zh: 所以如果摄影师就在这里灯光就在这里--比如漂亮的水银灯客户说：“Cameron,我想要一张走路时的快门照”

sentences.en: I will demonstrate for you now 10 years of accumulated model knowledge, because unlike cardiothoracic surgeons, it can just be distilled right now.
sentences.zh: 客户说：“Cameron,我想要一张走路时的快门照”这条修长的美腿先迈步，这条手臂放在后面，这条手臂放前面露出四分之三侧脸，来来回回，就这样，然后回头看你臆想中的朋友300，400，500次（笑声）

sentences.en: So, if the photographer is right there, the light is right there, like a nice HMI, and the client says, "We want a walking shot," this leg goes first, nice and long, this arm goes back, this arm goes forward, the head is at three quarters, and you just go back and forth,
sentences.zh: 300，400，500次（笑声）这看上去就像这样（笑声）希望不像中间那张那么怪我不知道那张是怎么回事儿

sentences.en: just do that, and then you look back at your imaginary friends, 300, 400, 500 times.
sentences.zh: 我不知道那张是怎么回事儿现实是，当你毕业后有了简历，做过了几份工作你就不能再说其它的了

sentences.en: (Laughter) It will look something like this.
sentences.zh: 你就不能再说其它的了所以如果你说你想成为美国总统

sentences.en: (Laughter) Hopefully less awkward than that one in the middle.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你说你想成为美国总统但你的简历上写着：有十年工作经验的内衣模特人们会笑着看你下一个人们常问的问题是：“他们会修照片吗？”

sentences.en: That was -- I don't know what happened there.
sentences.zh: 下一个人们常问的问题是：“他们会修照片吗？”是的，他们会修几乎所有照片

sentences.en: Unfortunately, after you've gone to school, and you have a résumé and you've done a few jobs, you can't say anything anymore, so if you say you want to be the President of the United States, but your résumé reads, "Underwear Model: 10 years,"
sentences.zh: 是的，他们会修几乎所有照片但这只是工作的一小部分这是我第一张模特照片也是我第一次穿比基尼我基至还没有过月经

sentences.en: people give you a funny look. The next question is, "Do they retouch all the photos?"
sentences.zh: 我基至还没有过月经我知道这有点私人，但那时我还很年轻

sentences.en: And yeah, they pretty much retouch all the photos, but that is only a small component of what's happening.
sentences.zh: 那时我还很年轻这是那张照片几个月前我跟祖母一起拍的照片这是拍照片当天

sentences.en: This picture is the very first picture that I ever took, and it's also the very first time that I had worn a bikini, and I didn't even have my period yet.
sentences.zh: 这是拍照片当天我朋友跟我在一起这是我拍法国Vogue杂志前几天前在睡衣party上拍的照片这是我在足球队和V杂志的照片

sentences.en: I know we're getting personal, but I was a young girl.
sentences.zh: 这是我在足球队和V杂志的照片

sentences.en: This is what I looked like with my grandma just a few months earlier.
sentences.zh: 这是我在足球队和V杂志的照片这是现在的我我希望你们明白的是

sentences.en: Here's me on the same day as this shoot.
sentences.zh: 我希望你们明白的是这些不是我自己的照片而是

sentences.en: My friend got to come. Here's me at a slumber party a few days before I shot French Vogue.
sentences.zh: 而是由一群专业人士制出的图象,(他们是)发型师，化装师，摄影师，造型师

sentences.en: Here's me on the soccer team and in V Magazine.
sentences.zh: (他们是)发型师，化装师，摄影师，造型师以及他们的助理，还有前期制作，后期制作

sentences.en: And here's me today. And I hope what you're seeing is that these pictures are not pictures of me.
sentences.zh: 以及他们的助理，还有前期制作，后期制作他们制造出了这些图象，而不是我下一个问题是“你能得到免费的东西吗？”

sentences.en: They are constructions, and they are constructions by a group of professionals, by hairstylists and makeup artists and photographers and stylists and all of their assistants and pre-production and post-production, and they build this.
sentences.zh: “你能得到免费的东西吗？”我确实有太多从没机会穿的8英寸高跟鞋，但是免费的东西却是我在现实生活中得到的。而这恰恰是我们不愿意谈的

sentences.en: That's not me. Okay, so the next question people always ask me is, "Do you get free stuff?"
sentences.zh: 却是我在现实生活中得到的。而这恰恰是我们不愿意谈的我在剑桥市长大有一次我走进一家商店却忘了带钱

sentences.en: (Laughter) I do have too many 8-inch heels which I never get to wear, except for earlier, but the free stuff that I get is the free stuff that I get in real life, and that's what we don't like to talk about.
sentences.zh: 有一次我走进一家商店却忘了带钱他们送了我一条裙子十几岁时，我跟朋友一起开车她是个糟糕的司机，闯了红灯我们被停车我只说了句：“长官抱歉”我们就继续上路了

sentences.en: I grew up in Cambridge, and one time I went into a store and I forgot my money and they gave me the dress for free.
sentences.zh: 我们就继续上路了我得到这些是因为我的外表而不是我是身份。有些人为了他们的外表

sentences.en: When I was a teenager, I was driving with my friend who was an awful driver and she ran a red and of course, we got pulled over, and all it took was a "Sorry, officer," and we were on our way.
sentences.zh: 而不是我是身份。有些人为了他们的外表而不是身份付出了代价。我住在纽约，去年有14万青年被停车搜身他们中百分之86是黑人和拉美人

sentences.en: And I got these free things because of how I look, not who I am, and there are people paying a cost for how they look and not who they are.
sentences.zh: 他们中百分之86是黑人和拉美人大多数是年轻的男孩子而在纽约年轻黑人和拉美男性总数只有17万7千所以，对他们来说，问题不是：“我会被停车吗”

sentences.en: I live in New York, and last year, of the 140,000 teenagers that were stopped and frisked, 86% of them were black and Latino, and most of them were young men.
sentences.zh: 所以，对他们来说，问题不是：“我会被停车吗”而是“我要被停几次？我什么时候会被停？“我在为这次演讲做调查时发现在美国13岁女孩儿群体中百分之53不喜欢她们的身体

sentences.en: And there are only 177,000 young black and Latino men in New York, so for them, it's not a question of, "Will I get stopped?"
sentences.zh: 百分之53不喜欢她们的身体到了17岁，这一比例上升至百分之78。那么最后一个问题是

sentences.en: but "How many times will I get stopped? When will I get stopped?"
sentences.zh: 那么最后一个问题是”当模特是什么感觉？“

sentences.en: When I was researching this talk, I found out that of the 13-year-old girls in the United States, 53% don't like their bodies, and that number goes to 78% by the time that they're 17.
sentences.zh: ”当模特是什么感觉？“我猜他们期待的答案是”如果你再瘦一点儿，你的头发再有光泽一些你就会很开心，很难以置信“当在后台时,我们会给出一个

sentences.en: So, the last question people ask me is, "What is it like to be a model?"
sentences.zh: 像这样的答案。我们说”能到处旅行和有创造力的，热情的，灵感不断的人一起工作真的很棒”

sentences.en: And I think the answer that they're looking for is, "If you are a little bit skinnier and you have shinier hair, you will be so happy and fabulous."
sentences.zh: 和有创造力的，热情的，灵感不断的人一起工作真的很棒”这不假，但这只是事实的一半因为我们永远不会在镜头前说的是,

sentences.en: And when we're backstage, we give an answer that maybe makes it seem like that.
sentences.zh: 因为我们永远不会在镜头前说的是,我永远不会说的是,“我没有安全感“

sentences.en: We say, "It's really amazing to travel, and it's amazing to get to work with creative, inspired, passionate people."
sentences.zh: “我没有安全感“因为我必须每天都要担心我看上去怎么样如果你曾经也想过

sentences.en: And those things are true, but they're only one half of the story, because the thing that we never say on camera, that I have never said on camera, is, "I am insecure."
sentences.zh: 如果你曾经也想过如果我的大腿更瘦，头发更好，我会更开心吗？你只要去看看模特就知道了因为她们有最瘦的大腿，最漂亮的头发，最酷的衣服

sentences.en: And I'm insecure because I have to think about what I look like every day.
sentences.zh: 因为她们有最瘦的大腿，最漂亮的头发，最酷的衣服而她们却可能是世界上最没有身理安全感的女人

sentences.en: And if you ever are wondering, "If I have thinner thighs and shinier hair, will I be happier?"
sentences.zh: 而她们却可能是世界上最没有身理安全感的女人所以当我为这次演讲做准备时时，发现很难为诚实找到一个平衡点。因为一方面如果我站在这儿，说

sentences.en: you just need to meet a group of models, because they have the thinnest thighs, the shiniest hair and the coolest clothes, and they're the most physically insecure women probably on the planet.
sentences.zh: 如果我站在这儿，说”看，我凭着天生的优势得到了这么多东西，”心里会不舒服可是如果这句话接着“可是这些都不能让我开心”也很不自在

sentences.en: When I was writing this talk, I found it very difficult to strike an honest balance, because on the one hand, I felt very uncomfortable to come out here and say, "Look I've received all these benefits from a deck stacked in my favor,"
sentences.zh: “可是这些都不能让我开心”也很不自在但最难的是去展现性别和种族歧视的职业传统因为我自己本身是最大的受益者但同时我又很开心并受尊重的站在这里

sentences.en: and it also felt really uncomfortable to follow that up with, "and it doesn't always make me happy."
sentences.zh: 但同时我又很开心并受尊重的站在这里趁着我还年轻，而不是已经工作了10，20或30年和模特行业间有越来越多的阻隔（不能获得最直接的感觉）

sentences.en: But mostly it was difficult to unpack a legacy of gender and racial oppression when I am one of the biggest beneficiaries.
sentences.zh: 和模特行业间有越来越多的阻隔（不能获得最直接的感觉）因为可能到那时我就不会讲我怎样得到第一份工作怎样付大学学费

sentences.en: But I'm also happy and honored to be up here and I think that it's great that I got to come before 10 or 20 or 30 years had passed and I'd had more agency in my career, because maybe then I wouldn't tell the story of how I got my first job,
sentences.zh: 怎样付大学学费这些现在看来是如此重要的东西如果这次演讲能使你有所受益，我希望是我们都能欣然接受图象的力量带来的我们所理解的成功和我们所理解的失败

sentences.en: or maybe I wouldn't tell the story of how I paid for college, which seems so important right now.
sentences.zh: 和我们所理解的失败谢谢（掌声）

sentences.en: If there's a takeaway to this talk, I hope it's that we all feel more comfortable acknowledging the power of image in our perceived successes and our perceived failures.
sentences.zh: 谢谢（掌声）

sentences.en: Thank you. (Applause)
sentences.zh: 谢谢。 （掌声）
